topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to evaluate the effectiveness of provider reimbursement methods from both a cost and quality viewpoint.

Calculate provider payments under various reimbursement methods
Evaluate standard contracting methods from a cost-effective and quality perspective
Evaluate accountable care organizations (ACO) and their impact on quality, utilization, and cost

topics.title: Disease Management
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to evaluate healthcare intervention programs.

outcomes.text: Describe, compare, and evaluate programs
Estimate savings, utilization rate changes, and return on investment
Apply the actuarially adjusted historical control methodology
Calculate chronic and non-chronic trends in a manner that reflects patient risk

topics.title: Medical Data
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to describe medical coding, sources of data, and data quality.

outcomes.text: Identify various medical terms, diseases, and treatment options relevant to health actuarial work
Identify and explain the use of coding sets used in health practice (CPT, ICD-10, DRG, Revenue Codes)
Describe how coding sets change over time and evaluate the potential impact on actuarial analysis
Evaluate impacts of changes in coding structures on provider reimbursement
Describe and interpret clinical policy bulletins
Distinguish between public and private data
Evaluate types of study methods and identify the method used for a given study
Research a question using multiple data sources

resources.citation: eLearning Module: FSA: Terminology and Analytical Use of Data for Healthcare Actuaries

topics.title: Social Determinants of Health
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to explain the social determinants of health (SDOH) and their impact on health care costs and policy.

outcomes.text: Explain the social determinants of health and how they impact the cost of healthcare
Describe program design and economic techniques used to measure program performance
Describe the current use of SDOH in traditional actuarial practices
Evaluate applications of SDOH derived statistics in actuarial models

topics.title: Predictive Analytics
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to apply the framework of predictive analytics to healthcare data and business applications.

outcomes.text: Describe common applications of predictive analytics in health care
Differentiate between types of risk score models
Describe common healthcare data sources for predictive modelling
Identify challenges specific to the use of healthcare claims in model development
Describe ethical considerations for actuaries in developing predictive models
